header.note: Derived from OpenStreetMap; this file is a Derivative Database under ODbL 1.0. Prices are ESTIMATES (priceEstimated: true), shown as "~$$ (est.)". priceBand is a team estimate, not data: fast_food/cafe/ice_cream/bubble_tea/bakery (amenity or cuisine) -> $; restaurant -> $$; cuisine steak_house/fine_dining/french -> $$$. OSM has no price tags here; nothing was copied from Google or Yelp. Cuisine and diet tags are normalized from OSM cuisine=* and diet:*=yes|only. opening_hours kept only when the opening_hours library parses it. Built by scripts/build-places.ts; see research/places-api.md.
